title: Volume Growth and Recurrence of Fractional Powers of the Laplace--Beltrami Operator
summary: Let $M$ be a connected geodesically complete Riemannian manifold without boundary, write $μ$ for Riemannian volume, and set $V(o,r)=μ(B(o,r))$ for geodesic balls centered at $o$. For $0<α<2$, let $X^{(α)}$ be the process obtained by subordinating Brownian motion with an independent $α/2$-stable subordinator; its $L^2$-generator is $-(-Δ)^{α/2}$. We prove that \[ \int^\infty\frac{dt}{V(o,t^{1/α})}=\infty \] implies that \(X^{(α)}\) is recurrent.
